\caption{Fold-1 architecture search. Each row is one variant trained and fine-tuned on a single cross-validation fold. $H$ is the hourly input length in hours, $h$ the hidden size of both branches, $p$ the dropout rate, $B$ the minibatch size, $b_f$ the forget-gate bias at initialisation and $\eta$ the \emph{pretraining} learning rate; the fine-tuning rate is swept separately and is $5\times10^{-4}$ in every row here. Samples seen per epoch are held at $1.024\times10^{7}$ across all variants, so $B$ is not confounded with training volume. The selection column is the median daily KGE on a held-out slice of the target training period, the only criterion the study's premise permits. The pretraining column is median hourly KGE on the source gauges' validation period, the metric the pretraining stage itself stops on; it is reported because it does not rank the variants the way the selection criterion does. $M_0$ and $M_1$ are median hourly KGE on the target gauges before and after daily-only fine-tuning. Rows are ordered by the grid, not by score. The emphasised row is the configuration adopted for all production runs, which differs from it only in minibatch size ($512$). Of the 26 variants launched, 4 diverged to a non-finite loss at learning rates of $10^{-3}$ and above and 3 (all with $h=256$) did not complete within the available wall clock; neither group is listed.}
